career_ladder.note: Agriculture Supervisors (Krishi Paryavekshak) are the grassroots agricultural extension and advisory officials in the Department of Agriculture, Government of Rajasthan. Governed by the Rajasthan Agriculture Subordinate Service Rules, 1978, they guide farmers on crop production techniques, high-yielding seed varieties, micro-irrigation systems, fertilizer dosages, soil health testing, and government subsidy schemes.

exam_scheme.note: The Agriculture Supervisor recruitment examination is a single-stage competitive objective written examination of 100 questions carrying 300 marks for a duration of 2 hours, followed by document verification of shortlisted candidates. For each correct response, 3 marks are awarded, and 1 mark is deducted for each incorrect answer (1/3rd negative marking). Minimum qualifying threshold is 40% aggregate marks (35% for SC/ST).

financial_package.note: Agriculture Supervisors are placed in Pay Matrix Level L-5 (Pay Band ₹5,200–₹20,200 with Grade Pay ₹2,400) under the Rajasthan Civil Services (Revised Pay) Rules, 2017. During the mandatory two-year probation period in Rajasthan, a fixed trainee remuneration of ₹14,600 per month is paid. Upon successful completion of probation, regular entry basic pay of ₹20,800 is drawn in Level L-5.
